Che cos'è EVIL, da dove vengono i dati d: What EVIL is, where the platform’s data comes from and what is real, simulated or educational. The project’s mission and how to contribute.
EVIL è una piattaforma didattica di cybe: EVIL is a cybersecurity training platform in Italian and English. It grew from a simple idea: you defend better what you truly understand. That is why we show how attacks work — in simulated environments and with public sources — always from the defender’s point of view.
<a href=\"#about-missione\" data-section: 1. Mission 2. The name 3. How the site is built 4. Where the data comes from 5. How to contribute
Formare persone capaci di unire competen: To train people who can combine advanced technical skill with a strong sense of responsibility: programmers, security professionals, ethical hackers, security researchers and software engineers. Knowledge is a neutral tool — like fire, it can cook or destroy — and we teach how to use it to protect. The rules that keep all of this legal and proper are on the Ethics and law page.
EVIL sta per <strong>Educational Vulnera: EVIL stands for Educational Vulnerability & Intelligence Lab: a teaching lab on vulnerabilities and intelligence. The name plays on the imagery of "evil" hacking precisely to flip it: here the same techniques are studied in order to defend.
Il sito è organizzato in tre aree, più l: The site is organised into three areas, plus the project pages:
<strong>Impara</strong> — <a href=\"/lea: Learn — paths, web attack simulator, virtual lab, cryptography studio, incident response timeline, quiz centre and glossary.
<strong>Analizza</strong> — <a href=\"/n: Analyse — cybersecurity news, historic breaches, malware catalogue, taxonomy and persistence and evasion.
<strong>Verifica</strong> — strumenti co: Verify — tools such as URL check, domain reconnaissance, file analysis and defensive OSINT, to be used only on authorised systems.
Tutto gira nel browser o su un server di: Everything runs in the browser or on a teaching server: the simulators send nothing to real systems.
La trasparenza sui dati è parte del prog: Transparency about data is part of the project. In short:
<strong>Reale</strong>: avvisi dei CERT: Real: CERT advisories and exploited vulnerabilities from public sources (CISA KEV, NIST NVD, CERT-AGID, CERT-EU). When a source does not give the country, we say so rather than inventing it.
<strong>Reale, documentato</strong>: cas: Real, documented: known cases rebuilt from public sources. Where a figure is not certain, the text stays general.
<strong>Didattico</strong>: schede di fa: Educational: profiles of documented families, compiled from public vendor and CERT reports.
<strong>Simulato</strong>: scenari e out: Simulated: hand-written scenarios and output for practice, with no connection to real systems.
<strong>Didattico</strong>: domande e sp: Educational: questions and explanations written for the platform.
Gli strumenti di analisi (DNS, TLS, head: The analysis tools (DNS, TLS, headers, OSINT) query public sources in real time about the target you enter, and only on domains you declare you are authorised for.
EVIL è un progetto in evoluzione. Hai tr: EVIL is an evolving project. Found a mistake in a profile, an inaccurate definition or a bug? Write to us from the Help page. If you find a vulnerability on the platform, follow responsible disclosure. The site’s code is public on GitHub.
